title: Integrating Latent Block Models into Variational Autoencoders for Disentangled Representation Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.20253v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce LBM-VAE, a novel framework that integrates Latent Block Models (LBMs) into Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) to jointly cluster observations and latent dimensions. Beyond its clustering capabilities, LBM-VAE provides a block-structured latent representation that naturally supports disentangled representation learning. In contrast to conventional approaches that associate each factor of variation with an individual latent dimension, our framework allows factors of variation to be encoded across groups of latent dimensions. Experimental results demonstrate the promising clustering performance of LBM-VAE, while achieving competitive results in disentangled representation learning. LBM-VAE highlights the potential of combining co-clustering and variational inference to learn structured and interpretable latent representations.

translated_title: 将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中以实现解耦表示学习
translated_abstract: 我们提出了LBM-VAE，这是一个将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中以联合对观测数据和潜在维度进行聚类的新型框架。除了聚类能力之外，LBM-VAE还提供了一种块结构的潜在表示，天然支持解耦表示学习。与传统方法将每个变化因素与单个潜在维度相关联不同，我们的框架允许变化因素在潜在维度组上进行编码。实验结果证明了LBM-VAE具有出色的聚类性能，同时在解耦表示学习方面取得了具有竞争力的结果。LBM-VAE凸显了将协同聚类与变分推断相结合以学习结构化和可解释潜在表示的潜力。
tldr: LBM-VAE通过将潜在块模型集成到变分自编码器中，利用块结构的潜在表示实现观测数据与潜在维度的联合聚类，并允许变化因素跨潜在维度组编码，从而有效支持解耦表示学习。
en_tdlr: LBM-VAE integrates Latent Block Models into Variational Autoencoders to jointly cluster observations and latent dimensions, enabling disentangled representation learning through block-structured latent representations where factors of variation are encoded across groups of latent dimensions.
